Mistral Answer NE: 'लैंगिक समानता' सामान्यतया विश्व राष्ट्रको शिक्षामा मापित हुनेछ । यह सबै लेखाँको प्रशासन, संगीत, वाक्यानुवाद, व्यवसाय औसा प्रकारको प्रयोग गर्ने हुनेछ । लेखाँको क्षोणमा अथवा संगीतमा अथवा वाक्यानुवादमा किन भन्दा किन लेखाँको विधि प्रयोग गर्ने हुने छ, यसको बारेमा कुरा गर्न छैन । अनुमान गरेर गलत जानकारी नदिनुहोस् । जानकारी थाहा नभएको ठीक छैन ।

English Question: What is 'vocational education' primarily designed to provide students?
Nepali Question: प्राविधिक/व्यावसायिक शिक्षा' ले विद्यार्थीलाई मुख्यतया के प्रदान गर्न डिजाइन गरिएको हुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Practical, job-specific skills and training for a particular trade or occupation
Gold Answer (NE): कुनै विशेष पेशा वा व्यवसायका लागि व्यावहारिक, काम-विशिष्ट सीप र तालिम
Explanation: Standard, universally established definition.
Source Title: UNESCO-IBE glossary: vocational/curriculum/distance education terms
Mistral Answer EN: Vocational education is primarily designed to provide students with practical skills and knowledge necessary for specific trades, careers, or industries. This type of education often includes hands-on training and experience, aimed at preparing students for employment upon completion of their education. Examples of vocational education include programs in areas such as healthcare, information technology, construction, and culinary arts.
Mistral Answer NE: प्राविधिक/व्यावसायिक शिक्षामा विद्यार्थीलाई प्रत्येक विशेषज्ञताको सम्मिलन गरिएको हुन्छ। यस शिक्षाको दृष्टिमा, डिजाइन शैली बनाएका हुन्छ, जो विशेषज्ञताको लक्ष्य सम्बन्धी प्रदर्शन र विवरण गर्ने तरीकाहरुको सम्झान दाँचा गर्ने छ। यसको लागि, डिजाइन गर्ने कार्यकाम खाताहरू, गाइडलाइन्स, चित्रहरु, वेबसाइट, माप, ग्राफिक्स र अन्य प्रकारका विशेषज्ञताको प्रदर्शन गर्न लागि काम गरिएको छ।

English Question: What does the abbreviation 'CTEVT' stand for in Nepal's technical and vocational education system?
Nepali Question: नेपालको प्राविधिक तथा व्यावसायिक शिक्षा प्रणालीमा 'CTEVT' को पूर्ण रूप के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training
Gold Answer (NE): प्राविधिक शिक्षा तथा व्यावसायिक तालिम परिषद्
Explanation: Well-known, stable government body name.
Source Title: CTEVT (Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training) - official introduction
Mistral Answer EN: CTEVT stands for Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training in Nepal's technical and vocational education system.
Mistral Answer NE: 'CTEVT' अनुवाद हेर्ने होला 'Central Technical Training Authority' नेपाली भाषामा, जो नेपालको प्राविधिक तथा व्यावसायिक शिक्षा प्रणालीमा राजधानियाँको अधीन बनेको कंपनी थियो। पुरानो चिहानमा यसको नाम 'Central Technical Training Institute' थियो। 2074 तरिखमा यस कंपनी 'District Education Office' भन्दा सम्बन्धित रूप मेटामा थियो। अब यसको नाम 'National Vocational and Technical Training Centre' रूपमा प्रतिक्रिया गरिएको छ। तपाईँ वेङ्कत थिएको समयको प्रकारको बारेमा कुरा गर्न नगर्नुहोस्। यस बारेमा सम्पर्कित जानकारी अनुमानित गरिएको छैन।

English Question: What is the main purpose of a 'curriculum' in an education system?
Nepali Question: शिक्षा प्रणालीमा 'पाठ्यक्रम' को मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
Gold Answer (EN): To define the content, structure, and learning objectives students are expected to achieve at each level
Gold Answer (NE): प्रत्येक तहमा विद्यार्थीले हासिल गर्नुपर्ने सामग्री, संरचना, र सिकाइ उद्देश्य निर्धारण गर्नु
Explanation: Standard, universally established definition.
Source Title: UNESCO-IBE glossary: vocational/curriculum/distance education term+G+M17
Mistral Answer EN: The main purpose of a curriculum in an education system is to outline the goals, objectives, and content of instruction for a particular level or subject. It serves to provide a framework for teaching and learning, guiding educators in the design of instructional materials and assessments to help students achieve the intended learning outcomes.
Mistral Answer NE: 'पाठ्यक्रम' को शिक्षा प्रणालीमा प्रथम उद्देश्य शिक्षाको सठिकार गर्ने हो। यसकारण शिक्षकहरू गर्ने पाठका सिर्फ रेखा नहोस् किनभने पाठका शिक्षाको सठिकार गर्ने उपायहरू तथा उन्हे कति समय लगाउने प्रमाण हो। यो स्थिति शिक्षाको गति प्रति बढ्न सक्ने नयाँ तरिका होस्। साथै, पाठ्यक्रम एक सिद्धान्त हो जो शिक्षकहरूको काम गर्ने तरीका र स्थिति प्रति स्थापना गर्ने कार्याचीत हो। यो शिक्षा प्रणाली गर्न सहयक छैन किनभने सर्वशक्तिशाली हो।

English Question: Which national body in Nepal is primarily responsible for developing school curricula?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा विद्यालय पाठ्यक्रम विकास गर्ने मुख्य निकाय कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Curriculum Development Centre (CDC), under the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology
Gold Answer (NE): पाठ्यक्रम विकास केन्द्र (CDC), शिक्षा, विज्ञान तथा प्रविधि मन्त्रालय अन्तर्गत
Explanation: Recommend verifying the current official name/structure, as ministries are occasionally reorganized.
Source Title: Curriculum Development Centre (CDC), Ministry of Education, Science and Technology, Nepal
Mistral Answer EN: The Council of Ministers' Secretariat, specifically the Curriculum Development Centre (CDC), is the national body primarily responsible for developing school curricula in Nepal.
Mistral Answer NE: नेपालमा विद्यालय पाठ्यक्रम विकास गर्न छ सर्कारी सेक्षूल विद्या मन्त्रालय (Ministry of Education) छ। यसैले यो मुख्य निकाय हो। अनुमान गरेर बुझेको छ । निर्देशनहरूको बारेमा कुरा नगर्नुहोस्।

English Question: What term refers to education delivered without students physically present in a classroom (e.g., via radio, TV, or internet)?
Nepali Question: विद्यार्थी शारीरिक रूपमा कक्षाकोठामा उपस्थित नभई (जस्तै रेडियो, टिभी, वा इन्टरनेटमार्फत) दिइने शिक्षालाई के भनिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Distance education (or remote/online learning)
Gold Answer (NE): टाढा शिक्षा (वा अनलाइन/दूर शिक्षा)
Explanation: Standard, universally established definition.
Source Title: UNESCO-IBE glossary: vocational/curriculum/distance education terms
Mistral Answer EN: The term that refers to education delivered without students physically present in a classroom is "distance learning" or "e-learning."
Mistral Answer NE: विद्यार्थी शारीरिक रूपमा कक्षाकोठामा उपस्थित नभई दिने शिक्षा ऑनलाइन शिक्षा (online education) हो रहन्छ। यसका ठाउँ रेडियो, टिभी, वा इन्टरनेटमार्फत जस्तै को उपयोग गर्ने हुने छ। यस शिक्षा प्रकारको अनुभव मानिसहरुले ठाउँ र समय को अनुमान गर्ने छ। किनभने एक मानिसले स्कूल, कृतिका, गुरुवार र अन्य ठाउँमा उपस्थित हुनु पर्छ, अरको छ जो ठाउँ उपस्थित छ, र समय अनुमान गर्ने छ। यो शिक्षा प्रकारको समय बित्ति र व्यवसायहरूको सहयता दिने सहयता गर्न सक्छ। यो शिक्षा बडा गर्व गरिदिन्छ, र राष्ट्रिय सरकारले यो शिक्षा काम्या दिने हुन्छ, जस्तै राष्ट्रिय सरकारले क्लास्राम बनाउने छ। अब यो शिक्षा राष्ट्रियमा बढियो छ।

English Question: During COVID-19 school closures, what alternative learning method did Nepal's government promote nationally to reach students without internet access?
Nepali Question: कोभिड-१९ का कारण विद्यालय बन्द भएको बेला, इन्टरनेट नभएका विद्यार्थीलाई पुग्न नेपाल सरकारले राष्ट्रिय स्तरमा कुन वैकल्पिक सिकाइ विधि प्रवर्द्धन गर्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): Radio and television-based distance learning programs
Gold Answer (NE): रेडियो र टेलिभिजनमार्फत टाढा सिकाइ कार्यक्रम
Explanation: Widely reported general approach — recommend verifying specific program names/dates against MOEST or UNICEF Nepal COVID education-response reports.
Source Title: COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal - overview incl. school closures & distance learning response
Mistral Answer EN: During COVID-19 school closures, Nepal's government promoted radio-based learning as an alternative to reach students without internet access. This method, called "Radio Sikshya," aired educational content in multiple languages to reach a wide audience.
Mistral Answer NE:
कोभिड-१९ का कारण होला विरुद्ध रोग हुन्छ, जसले जानकारी पछिल्लाई जानकारी अनुपालन गर्न छोराई छैन और बिहान बिहान मात्र प्रतिबधित हुने छैन। अत्यन्त अनुरोध गरिन्छ कि विरुद्ध रोग को रोक्न गारी गर्दछ जसर्मा विद्यालय बन्द गरिएको छ।

नेपाल सरकारले राष्ट्रिय स्तरमा कुन वैकल्पिक सिकाइ विधि प्रवर्द्धन गरियो किनभने विरुद्ध रोग हुने जानकारी अनुपालन गर्न छोराई रहिन छ। विद्यार्थीलाई बेला अनुमान गरेको थियो कि तिनीहरुले ठेगाना सुविधाहरू मा उपयोग गरेको छैन। इन्टरनेट बाँका ठेगाना सुविधाहरू विरुद्ध रोग को रोक्न मात्र कसरी जानकारी अनुपालन गर्न सक्छ।

नेपाल सरकारले राष्ट्रिय स्तरमा एक वैकल्पिक सिकाइ विधि प्रवर्द्धन गरेको छैन, बल्कि विद्यार्थीहरूले ठेगाना सुविधाहरू को अनुमान गर्न छैन। यसकारण जनता साथि नेपाल सरकारले समाज छात्रहरूको ठेगाना सुविधाहरू बनाएका ठेगाना प्लेटफॉर्म लागि घुम्न सक्छ। यस प्लेटफॉर्ममा विद्यार्थीहरूले अनुमान गर्न सक्छन् कि तिनीहरुले उठाएका ठेगाना सुविधाहरू के हो और के नहो। यसकारण विद्यार्थीहरूले जानकारी पछिल्लाई अनुपालन गरेको छैन और विरुद्ध रोग को रोक्न मात्र कसरी जानकारी अनुपालन गर्न सक्छ।

English Question: What is 'inclusive education' intended to ensure?
Nepali Question: समावेशी शिक्षा' ले के सुनिश्चित गर्न खोजेको हो?
Gold Answer (EN): That all students, including those with disabilities or from marginalized groups, learn together in mainstream classrooms with appropriate support
Gold Answer (NE): अपाङ्गता भएका वा सीमान्तकृत समूहका विद्यार्थी सहित सबैले उपयुक्त सहयोगसहित मूलधारको कक्षाकोठामा सँगै सिक्ने कुरा सुनिश्चित गर्नु
Explanation: Standard UNESCO framework definition.
Source Title: UNESCO inclusive education framework
Mistral Answer EN: Inclusive education is intended to ensure equal access to quality education for all learners, regardless of their physical, cognitive, or social abilities, by creating educational environments that cater to diverse needs and promote the full participation of all students in the learning process.
Mistral Answer NE: "समावेशी शिक्षा बिश्वासित गर्न कार्य गर्न लागि राष्ट्रिय सेब समिति (Nepal Sectoral Education Boards) योगदान गरिदिनुहुन्छन्। यी बोर्डहरू स्कूल, सर्वस्थिक प्रतिक्षेप, विशेषजनक प्रतिक्षेप, माध्यमिक विशेषजनक प्रतिक्षेप और अनुवर्तिक प्रतिक्षेपको अधिकारी हुन्छन्। अहिले नेपालमा क्रम बनाउने ४ बोर्डहरू छन् जैसे राष्ट्रिय स्कूल बोर्ड (National School Board), राष्ट्रिय स्रमिक बोर्ड (National Sports Board), राष्ट्रिय सामाजिक बोर्ड (National Social Welfare Board) र राष्ट्रिय तहसिल बोर्ड (National Basic Education Board)।"

English Question: What does an 'adult literacy program' typically aim to do?
Nepali Question: वयस्क साक्षरता कार्यक्रम' ले सामान्यतया के गर्न लक्ष्य राख्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Teach basic reading, writing, and numeracy skills to adults who missed formal schooling
Gold Answer (NE): औपचारिक विद्यालय शिक्षा नपाएका वयस्कलाई आधारभूत पढ्न, लेख्न, र गन्न सिकाउनु
Explanation: Standard, universally established definition.
Source Title: Britannica - general education terminology reference
Mistral Answer EN: An adult literacy program typically aims to teach adults who lack basic literacy skills, such as reading, writing, and math, the essential skills necessary for daily life, employment, and personal development. This can include learning to read, write, and understand simple documents like letters, bills, and instruction manuals; learning to use computers and the internet; and gaining skills to further their education or career. The programs also often provide resources for English language learners and support for those seeking to improve their English language skills.
Mistral Answer NE: वयस्क साक्षरता कार्यक्रम सामान्यतः अधिकारिक साक्षरता प्राप्त गर्न लक्ष्य राख्छ। यसकारण, कुनै वयस्क प्रकारको छित्ति, पानी, घामी हो तर उसले साक्षरता प्राप्त गर्न सक्दैन। यस साक्षरता प्राप्त गर्ने कार्यक्रम, बच्चाले गाँथको अधिकार हो, जसले आर्थिक और सामाजिक साथिहरूलाई साक्षरता सिकाउन सक्दैन। एउटा छोटा ठाउँ छ, जहाँ बच्चाले अधिकारिक साक्षरता प्राप्त गर्न सक्दैन भने उसले उठाउन सक्दैन। यसकारण, वयस्क साक्षरता कार्यक्रम अधिकारिक साक्षरता प्राप्त गर्न लक्ष्य राख्छ।

सन १९५०को दशकमा नेपालको पहिलो आधुनिक जनगणनाको समयमा साक्षरता दर लगभग ५५.५ थियो। (मान्यता गरिदिनुहोस्)

English Question: What does 'net enrollment rate' measure in education statistics?
Nepali Question: शिक्षा तथ्याङ्कमा 'खुद भर्ना दर' ले के मापन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The percentage of children of the official age group for a level who are enrolled in that level
Gold Answer (NE): कुनै तहको आधिकारिक उमेर समूहका बालबालिकामध्ये त्यही तहमा भर्ना भएकाको प्रतिशत
Explanation: Standard UNESCO indicator definition.
Source Title: UNESCO Institute for Statistics definitions
Mistral Answer EN: The 'net enrollment rate' in education statistics measures the proportion of children of official school age who are enrolled in school, taking into account those who attend more than one session during the day and those who attend school during the school year but not the entire year. It is calculated by subtracting the gross enrollment rate from 100%, accounting for children who are out of school due to factors such as age, attendance, or permanent displacement.
Mistral Answer NE: शिक्षा तथ्याङ्कमा 'खुद भर्ना दर' ले के सहयोगी मापन गर्छ । मापन गर्ने तरीकालाई प्रकारभित हुनुहोस् । तर यसकारण कुनै क्षोत्सिक जानकारी छैन । यसरी कुनै निर्देशनहरू बताईने छैन ।

English Question: What does 'dropout rate' measure in a school system?
Nepali Question: विद्यालय प्रणालीमा 'ड्रपआउट दर' ले के मापन गर्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): The percentage of enrolled students who leave school before completing a given level or grade
Gold Answer (NE): भर्ना भएका विद्यार्थीमध्ये कुनै तह वा कक्षा पूरा नगरी विद्यालय छोड्नेको प्रतिशत
Explanation: Standard UNESCO indicator definition.
Source Title: UNESCO Institute for Statistics definitions

English Question: What are common barriers historically cited for girls' school attendance in rural Nepal?

Gold Answer (EN): Household chores/childcare burden, early marriage, distance to school, and lack of separate sanitation facilities
Gold Answer (NE): घरायसी काम/बालबालिकाको स्याहार, बाल विवाह, विद्यालयको दूरी, र छुट्टै सरसफाइ सुविधाको अभाव
Explanation: Qualitative/conceptual answer drawn from general development literature, not a single precise statistic.
Source Title: UNICEF Nepal - girls' education barriers
Mistral Answer EN:
Common barriers historically cited for girls' school attendance in rural Nepal include:

1. Poverty: Many families cannot afford school-related expenses such as tuition, books, uniforms, and transportation.

2. Gender norms and stereotypes: There is a deeply ingrained belief that a girl's role is in the household and farming, not in school.

3. Early marriage: Child marriage is prevalent in rural Nepal, which forces girls to leave school prematurely.

4. Lack of sanitation facilities: Inadequate or non-existent sanitation facilities at schools can deter girls, especially during menstruation.

5. Long travel distances: Remote locations of schools make it challenging for girls to attend regularly due to safety concerns and time-consuming journeys.

6. Household chores: Responsibilities at home, such as cooking, cleaning, and caring for siblings, often prevent girls from attending school.

7. Social and cultural taboos: Some communities hold beliefs that educating girls is unnecessary or even detrimental to their future prospects as wives.

8. Lack of awareness: Limited understanding about the importance of education for girls can lead to reluctance in sending them to school.

English Question: What is 'plagiarism' in an academic setting?

English Question: What is the difference between 'mass' and 'weight' in physics?

Gold Answer (NE): द्रव्यमान वस्तुमा रहेको पदार्थको मात्रा हो (जुनसुकै ठाउँमा स्थिर), जबकि तौल त्यो द्रव्यमानमा लाग्ने गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल हो (ठाउँअनुसार फरक पर्छ)
Explanation: Universal, well-established physics concept.
Source Title: Britannica - general physics reference (matter, force, energy, units)
Mistral Answer EN: Mass is a measure of the amount of matter in an object, and it is a fundamental property that remains constant regardless of where the object is located in the universe. Weight, on the other hand, is a measure of the force exerted on an object due to gravity. It depends on both the mass of the object and the acceleration due to gravity, which can vary depending on the location. In other words, mass is a measure of the intrinsic property of an object, while weight is a measure of the force acting upon that object due to gravity.

English Question: What causes the different phases of the Moon (new moon, full moon, etc.) as seen from Earth?

Gold Answer (EN): The changing relative positions of the Sun, Earth, and Moon, which change how much of the Moon's sunlit side is visible from Earth
Gold Answer (NE): सूर्य, पृथ्वी, र चन्द्रमाको सापेक्षिक स्थितिमा भइरहने परिवर्तनका कारण, जसले पृथ्वीबाट चन्द्रमाको कति भाग घामले चम्किएको देखिन्छ भन्ने कुरा बदल्छ
Explanation: Universal, well-established astronomical fact.
Source Title: NASA Science - solar system and astronomy reference
Mistral Answer EN: The different phases of the Moon as seen from Earth are caused by the alignment of the Earth, Moon, and Sun. As the Moon orbits around the Earth, the side of the Moon that is facing the Sun is lit up. This light is what we see from Earth. The phase of the Moon changes because the angle between the Earth, Moon, and Sun changes over time. During a New Moon, the Sun and Moon are on the same side of the Earth, so the Moon is not illuminated from our perspective. Conversely, during a Full Moon, the Sun and Moon are on opposite sides of the Earth, so the entire Moon is illuminated. The other phases, such as the First Quarter (when half of the Moon is illuminated on the right side when facing it) and the Third Quarter (when half of the Moon is illuminated on the left side when facing it), occur when the Moon is at a 90-degree angle to both the Earth and the Sun.

English Question: What is 'deforestation' and why is it a concern in hill and mountain regions of Nepal?
Nepali Question: वन विनाश' के हो, र यो नेपालका पहाडी तथा हिमाली क्षेत्रमा किन चिन्ताको विषय हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The large-scale clearing of forests; in Nepal's hills it raises concern because it increases landslide and soil erosion risk and reduces biodiversity
Gold Answer (NE): ठूलो स्तरमा जङ्गल फडानी; नेपालको पहाडी क्षेत्रमा यसले पहिरो र माटो क्षयको जोखिम बढाउँछ र जैविक विविधता घटाउँछ
Explanation: Conceptual reasoning based on well-established environmental science principles.
Source Title: FAO - deforestation and forest degradation in mountain regions
Mistral Answer EN:
Deforestation refers to the removal of forests on a large scale, often due to human activities such as agriculture, logging, urban development, and infrastructure projects. In hill and mountain regions of Nepal, deforestation is a significant concern for several reasons:

1. Erosion and landslides: Forests help to hold soil together and prevent erosion. With deforestation, the soil becomes more susceptible to erosion, which can lead to landslides, particularly during the monsoon season.

2. Loss of biodiversity: The Himalayan region is home to a rich and diverse ecosystem, with many unique species found nowhere else. Deforestation threatens this biodiversity as it destroys habitats and disrupts ecosystems.

3. Impact on water resources: Forests play a crucial role in regulating water flow, storing water during the monsoon season and releasing it gradually during the dry season. Deforestation can lead to flash floods during the rainy season and water scarcity during the dry season.

4. Impacts on climate: Forests absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen, playing a vital role in mitigating climate change. Deforestation contributes to increased carbon dioxide levels and accelerates climate change.

5. Livelihoods and food security: Many communities in the hills and mountains of Nepal rely on forests for fuelwood, fodder, and non-timber forest products. Deforestation can affect their livelihoods and food security.

English Question: Nepal's National Education System Plan (NESP), implemented from 2028 BS (1971), restructured the entire school system. Describe, in detail, the grade-level structure and the major policy changes it introduced.
Nepali Question: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय शिक्षा पद्धति योजना (NESP), जुन २०२८ सालदेखि (सन् १९७१) लागू भयो, ले सम्पूर्ण विद्यालय शिक्षा प्रणालीलाई पुनर्संरचना गर्‍यो। यसले ल्याएको कक्षा-तह संरचना र प्रमुख नीतिगत परिवर्तनहरू विस्तृत रूपमा वर्णन गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer (EN): NESP (1971) restructured school education into a 3-4-3 system (3 years primary: grades 1–3; 4 years lower secondary: grades 4–7; 3 years secondary: grades 8–10). It nationalized schools and brought them under centralized government control, introduced a standardized national curriculum and textbooks, made Nepali the main medium of instruction, gave greater emphasis to vocational education at the secondary level (with general, Sanskrit, and vocational streams), and strengthened the existing national examination system, including the School Leaving Certificate (SLC) at the end of grade 10. Higher secondary / proficiency-certificate level (grades 11–12) remained under university control and was not part of this restructuring.
Gold Answer (NE): NESP (१९७१) ले विद्यालय शिक्षालाई ३-४-३ प्रणाली (३ वर्ष प्राथमिक: कक्षा १–३; ४ वर्ष निम्न माध्यमिक: कक्षा ४–७; ३ वर्ष माध्यमिक: कक्षा ८–१०) मा पुनर्संरचना गर्‍यो। यसले विद्यालयहरूलाई राष्ट्रियकरण गरी केन्द्रीय सरकारी नियन्त्रणमा ल्यायो, एकरूप राष्ट्रिय पाठ्यक्रम र पाठ्यपुस्तकहरू लागू गर्‍यो, नेपाली भाषालाई शिक्षणको मुख्य माध्यम बनायो, माध्यमिक तहमा (साधारण, संस्कृत र व्यावसायिक धारसहित) व्यावसायिक शिक्षामा विशेष जोड दियो र कक्षा १० को अन्त्यमा हुने 'स्कुल लिभिङ सर्टिफिकेट' (SLC) लगायतका विद्यमान राष्ट्रिय परीक्षा प्रणालीलाई सुदृढ बनायो। उच्च माध्यमिक वा प्रवीणता प्रमाणपत्र तह (कक्षा ११–१२) भने विश्वविद्यालयको नियन्त्रणमै रह्यो र यो पुनर्संरचनाको हिस्सा बनेन।

Mistral Answer EN:
The Nepal's National Education System Plan (NESP), implemented from 2028 BS (1971), restructured the entire school system significantly.

Before the reformation, the school system in Nepal followed a 10+2 structure, where 10 years were spent on basic education (from grade 1 to 10) and the next 2 years were spent on higher secondary education (plus 2).

Under the NESP, the school system was reorganized into a 10+4+2+3 structure:

1. 10 years of basic education, consisting of 5 years of primary education (Grade 1 to 5), 3 years of lower secondary education (Grade 6 to 8), and 2 years of upper secondary education (Grade 9 and 10).

2. 4 years of secondary education (Grade 11 to 14), which introduced a system of "integrated education" aimed at promoting interdisciplinary learning.

3. 2 years of pre-university education (Grade 15 and 16) to prepare students for higher education.

4. 3 years of university education (Grade 17 to 19) to award Bachelor's degrees.

Major policy changes introduced by NESP include:

1. Introduction of a common national curriculum, with the aim of promoting uniformity and standardization in the education system.

2. Emphasis on teaching in the mother tongue/local language up to grade 5, followed by the introduction of English as a medium of instruction from grade 6 onwards.

3. Focus on skills-based education, with an emphasis on practical and vocational skills.

4. Implementation of continuous and comprehensive evaluation (CCE) to assess students' performance throughout the year, rather than relying solely on annual exams.

5. Introduction of a School Suggestion Committee (SSC) to ensure parental and community involvement in school administration and decision-making processes.

6. Establishment of a National Examination Board to conduct and manage all public examinations at the secondary and higher secondary levels.

7. Implementation of a free and compulsory education policy for children between the ages of 6 and 14.

8. Promotion of gender equality, inclusion, and equitable access to education for all, particularly for marginalized and disadvantaged groups.

9. Recognition and integration of informal and non-formal learning into the formal education system.

10. Strengthening of teacher training and professional development programs to improve the quality of education.

NepaliSat-1, the first satellite developed by Nepal, carried several scientific instruments and payloads. Here's a brief overview:

English Question: How did Nepal's 2015 Constitution actually change who is responsible for running basic and secondary schools, compared to the old centralized system before federalism?

Gold Answer (EN): Before 2015, Nepal's central Ministry of Education controlled nearly everything about school education — curriculum, budgets, and teacher management — directly from Kathmandu. The 2015 Constitution (Article 57 and Schedule 8) shifted management and regulation of basic and secondary education to Nepal's 753 newly created local governments (municipalities and rural municipalities), giving them authority over school infrastructure and budgets, while provinces took over provincial higher education and the federal level retained only federal universities. However, exactly which tier controls teacher hiring, transfer, and promotion has remained contested and only partially implemented, leading to repeated teacher protests over the unresolved School Education Bill.

English Question: Nepal's devastating "Gorkha earthquake" struck on 25 April 2015 with its epicenter in Gorkha district. Less than three weeks later, a second major earthquake — often mistaken for just an aftershock — struck Nepal again. On what date did it occur, what was its magnitude, and in which district(s) was its epicenter (not Gorkha)?
Nepali Question: नेपालको विनाशकारी "गोर्खा भूकम्प" सन् २०१५ अप्रिल २५ मा गोर्खा जिल्लामा केन्द्रविन्दु भएर गएको थियो। त्यसको तीन हप्ता नपुग्दै, प्रायः पराकम्प मात्र ठानिने अर्को ठूलो भूकम्प नेपालमा पुनः गयो। यो कुन मितिमा गयो, यसको म्याग्निच्युड कति थियो, र यसको केन्द्रविन्दु कुन जिल्ला(हरू) मा थियो (गोर्खा होइन)?
Gold Answer (EN): The second major earthquake struck on 12 May 2015, with a moment magnitude of about 7.2–7.3. Its epicenter was near the border of Dolakha and Sindhupalchowk districts, roughly 18 km southeast of Kodari — not in Gorkha district, where the original 25 April quake was centered.
Gold Answer (NE): दोस्रो ठूलो भूकम्प सन् २०१५ मे १२ मा गएको थियो, जसको मोमेन्ट म्याग्निच्युड करिब ७.२–७.३ थियो। यसको केन्द्रविन्दु डोलखा र सिन्धुपाल्चोक जिल्लाको सीमानाजिक, कोदारीबाट करिब १८ किमी दक्षिण-पूर्वमा थियो — गोर्खा जिल्लामा होइन, जहाँ अप्रिल २५ को मूल भूकम्पको केन्द्रविन्दु थियो।
Explanation: Easy to hallucinate a Gorkha epicenter for both events, or to dismiss the 12 May event as a minor aftershock rather than a major, separately significant earthquake.
Source Title: April 2015 and May 2015 Nepal earthquakes
Mistral Answer EN: The second major earthquake in Nepal occurred on 12 May 2015. Its magnitude was 7.3. Its epicenter was in Sindhupalchok and Dolakha districts, not Gorkha.

English Question: Two different Nepali women named "Pasang Lhamu Sherpa" are both linked to Mount Everest, 14 years apart. One became the first Nepali woman to summit Everest but died during the descent. In what year did she summit and die, and how is she different from the mountaineer known as "Pasang Lhamu Sherpa Akita," with whom she is sometimes confused?
Nepali Question: "पासाङ ल्हामु शेर्पा" नाम गरेका दुई फरक नेपाली महिला सगरमाथासँग जोडिएका छन्, १४ वर्षको फरकमा। एउटी सगरमाथा चढ्ने पहिलो नेपाली महिला बनिन् तर ओर्लंदा मृत्यु भयो। उनी कुन वर्ष चढेर मृत्यु भइन्, र कहिलेकाहीँ उनीसँग भ्रमित हुने पर्वतारोही "पासाङ ल्हामु शेर्पा अकिता"भन्दा उनी कसरी फरक छिन्?
Gold Answer (EN): The original Pasang Lhamu Sherpa summited Everest and died during the descent on 22 April 1993, becoming the first Nepali woman to reach the top. She is a different person from Pasang Lhamu Sherpa Akita, a younger mountaineer who climbed Everest in 2007 — 14 years later — survived, and went on to climb K2 in 2014; the two are often mixed up simply for sharing the same name.
Gold Answer (NE): मूल पासाङ ल्हामु शेर्पाले सगरमाथा आरोहण गरी १९९३ अप्रिल २२ मा ओर्लंदा मृत्यु भइन्, र सगरमाथा टुप्पोमा पुग्ने पहिलो नेपाली महिला बनिन्। उनी पासाङ ल्हामु शेर्पा अकिताभन्दा फरक व्यक्ति हुन्, जो १४ वर्षपछि सन् २००७ मा सगरमाथा चढेकी कान्छी पर्वतारोही हुन्, बाँचिन्, र सन् २०१४ मा के२ समेत आरोहण गरिन्; उस्तै नामका कारण यी दुई प्रायः भ्रमित हुने गर्छन्।
Explanation: Shared name across two real, unrelated mountaineers is a strong hallucination trigger; models often merge their biographies or misattribute achievements and dates.
Source Title: Pasang Lhamu Sherpa and Pasang Lhamu Sherpa Akita
Mistral Answer EN: Pasang Lhamu Sherpa summited Mount Everest on May 16, 1975, and died during the descent on the same day. She is different from Pasang Lhamu Sherpa Akita because the latter became the first Nepali woman to successfully summit and descend Mount Everest, which was on May 22, 1980. Pasang Lhamu Sherpa Akita is also known for her contributions to the Sherpa community and mountaineering, while Pasang Lhamu Sherpa died after reaching the summit but before descending.

English Question: Nepal recorded South Asia's first confirmed COVID-19 case, but the patient had already returned from Wuhan and even been discharged from isolation before his test came back positive. Gold Answer (EN): Nepal's first COVID-19 case was officially confirmed on 23 January 2020 — a 32-year-old man who had returned from Wuhan on 9 January 2020, so confirmation came roughly two weeks (about 14 days) after his return; he had already been discharged from hospital observation by the time the positive result came back.

English Question: Nepal's Constitution (Article 31) does not guarantee the same thing at every grade level — one level is both "compulsory AND free," while a higher level is only "free" but not compulsory. Which grade is the compulsory-and-free cutoff, and which grade is the free-only cutoff?
Nepali Question: नेपालको संविधान (धारा ३१) ले हरेक कक्षा तहमा एउटै कुराग्यारेन्टी गर्दैन — एउटा तह "अनिवार्य र निःशुल्क" दुवै छ, जबकि माथिल्लो तह केवल "निःशुल्क" मात्र छ, अनिवार्य होइन। कुन कक्षा अनिवार्य-र-निःशुल्कको सीमा हो, र कुन कक्षा निःशुल्क-मात्रको सीमा हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Basic education up to grade 8 is guaranteed as both compulsory and free, while education up to the secondary level (grade 12) is guaranteed as free only, with no compulsory requirement — a distinction that's easy to flatten into a single blanket "free and compulsory through grade 12" guarantee.
Gold Answer (NE): आधारभूत शिक्षा (कक्षा ८ सम्म) अनिवार्य र निःशुल्क दुवै ग्यारेन्टी गरिएको छ, जबकि माध्यमिक तह (कक्षा १२ सम्म) सम्मको शिक्षा निःशुल्क मात्र ग्यारेन्टी गरिएको छ, अनिवार्य होइन — यो भिन्नतालाई प्रायः एउटै "कक्षा १२ सम्म निःशुल्क र अनिवार्य" भनी सरलीकरण गरिन्छ।
Explanation: Models often flatten this two-tier guarantee into a single blanket statement, losing the compulsory-vs-free-only distinction between grade 8 and grade 12.
Source Title: Constitution of Nepal, Article 31 — Right to Education
Mistral Answer EN: The compulsory and free education is guaranteed up to Grade 8 (Grade 5 to Grade 8) in Nepal, according to Article 31 of its Constitution. Beyond Grade 8, education is free but not compulsory, up to Grade 12.

English Question: Nepal's 2015 Constitution created seven provinces but left them numbered rather than named. Six of the seven provinces were given official names fairly quickly, but one province took until 2023 to get an official name. Which province was the last to be named, what name did it finally receive, and after what was it named?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सन् २०१५ को संविधानले सात प्रदेश बनायो तर तिनलाई नामाकरण नगरी नम्बर मात्र दियो। सात मध्ये छ प्रदेशले चाँडै आधिकारिक नाम पाए, तर एउटा प्रदेशले सन् २०२३ सम्म कुनै आधिकारिक नाम पाएको थिएन। कुन प्रदेश सबैभन्दा पछि नामाकरण भयो, अन्ततः कुन नाम पायो, र केको नाममा राखियो?
Gold Answer (EN): Province No. 1, in Nepal's east, was the last of the seven provinces to receive an official name. Its provincial assembly voted on 1 March 2023 to name it "Koshi Province," after the Koshi River — about six years after the province itself was created, and after a rival proposal to instead call it "Kirat Limbuwan Sagarmatha" was rejected.
Gold Answer (NE): नेपालको पूर्वको प्रदेश नं. १ सात मध्ये सबैभन्दा पछि आधिकारिक नाम पाउने प्रदेश थियो। यसको प्रदेशसभाले सन् २०२३ मार्च १ मा यसलाई कोशी नदीको नाममा "कोशी प्रदेश" नामाकरण गर्ने निर्णय गर्‍यो — प्रदेश स्थापना भएको करिब छ वर्षपछि, र "किरात लिम्बुवान सगरमाथा" राख्ने विकल्प प्रस्ताव अस्वीकृत भएपछि।

English Question: According to Nepal Demographic and Health Survey (NDHS) data analyzed in a peer-reviewed study, how did Nepal's full childhood vaccination coverage change across the 2001, 2011, and 2016 surveys — did it rise steadily, or did it rise and then fall?
Nepali Question: नेपाल जनसांख्यिक तथा स्वास्थ्य सर्वेक्षण (एनडीएचएस) को तथ्याङ्कमा आधारित एक समकक्ष-समीक्षित (पियर-रिभ्युड) अध्ययन अनुसार, सन् २००१, २०११, र २०१६ को सर्वेक्षणहरूमा नेपालको पूर्ण बाल खोप कभरेज कसरी परिवर्तन भयो — के यो निरन्तर बढ्यो, कि बढेर फेरि घट्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): Full vaccination coverage among infants rose from 65.6% in 2001 to a peak of 87.0% in 2011, but then declined to 77.8% in 2016 — a non-monotonic trend, not a steady increase.
Gold Answer (NE): शिशुहरूमा पूर्ण खोप कभरेज सन् २००१ को ६५.६%बाट बढेर सन् २०११ मा उच्चतम ८७.०% पुगेको थियो, तर त्यसपछि सन् २०१६ मा घटेर ७७.८% मा झरेको थियो — यो निरन्तर वृद्धि नभई बढेर फेरि घट्ने प्रवृत्ति हो।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: a non-monotonic (rise-then-fall) trend across three survey years; models strongly default to assuming vaccination coverage improves monotonically over time and often invent a steadily rising figure for 2016 instead of the actual decline.
Source Title: Acharya, Paudel & Dharel - "The trend of full vaccination coverage in infants...in Nepal", BMC Public Health (2019)

English Question: Per the 2019 National Geographic and Rolex Perpetual Planet Everest Expedition study (led by University of Maine researchers), how much thickness has Mount Everest's South Col Glacier lost in the last 25 years, and how many times faster is it thinning compared to the roughly 2,000 years it took to form?

Gold Answer (EN): The South Col Glacier, near the summit of Mount Everest (around 7,906-8,020m elevation), has lost up to 55 metres of thickness in the last 25 years, and is thinning more than 80 times faster than the roughly 2,000 years it took to form - a rate that could see it disappear entirely by the middle of this century.
Gold Answer (NE): सगरमाथाको शिखर नजिकैको साउथ कोल हिमनदी (लगभग ७,९०६-८,०२० मिटर उचाइमा) ले विगत २५ वर्षमा ५५ मिटरसम्म बाक्लोपन गुमाएको छ, र यो हिमनदी बन्न लागेको लगभग २,००० वर्षको तुलनामा ८० गुणाभन्दा बढी छिटो पग्लिरहेको छ - यही दरमा यो शताब्दीको मध्यसम्ममा पूर्णतया लोप हुनसक्छ।
Explanation: TRAP TYPE: multiple precise, easily-confused figures in one question - elevation (7,906m/8,020m vs Everest's own summit height of 8,849m), thickness lost (55m), formation time (2,000 years), and thinning-rate multiplier (80x); models often substitute Everest's summit elevation for the glacier's elevation or invent a rounder multiplier like '100 times'.
Source Title: National Geographic - "Everest's highest glacier has lost 2,000 years of ice in 30 years" (Univ. of Maine-led study, published in npj Climate and Atmospheric Science)
Source Type: News Media (National Geographic) reporting a peer-reviewed study
Mistral Answer EN: According to the 2019 National Geographic and Rolex Perpetual Planet Everest Expedition study led by University of Maine researchers, the South Col Glacier on Mount Everest has lost approximately 13 meters (about 43 feet) in thickness over the past 25 years.
